entities.summary: Charles Emmanuel, Landgrave of Hesse-Rotenburg was landgrave of Hessen-Rotenburg between 1778 and 1812. He was named after his uncle Charles Emmanuel III of Sardinia, husband of his aunt Polyxena of Hesse-Rotenburg.
